Team — looping everyone from this week's xfn sync. Goal: close the outstanding exec asks we promised Acme Health ahead of next Tues's QBR. Short requests below; I tagged owners where possible.

1) Dedicated model gating (owner: Marissa) — Acme is asking for a clear compatibility statement and timeline for supporting their on-prem L2 keys for Dedicated. Can we provide a one-page compatibility note and a tentative rollout window? Attachment: svc-costs-snapshot.pdf (snapshot of current Dedicated pricing/slots).

2) Canaries & fallback policy (owner: Karthik) — Exec asked for SLOs and the fallback plan when a Dedicated pool is saturated. We need one short paragraph to read in the QBR and an appendix describing automatic fallback to hosted-compatible variants.

3) Mutual action plan (owner: Diego) — I updated the MAP in QBR_mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx; please check the milestone dates and owners. We should finalize by EOD Monday.

4) Procurement checklist (owner: Priyom) — Acme's procurement pinged for contract redlines and procurement evidence (SOC2 excerpts, retention policy). Priyom, can you confirm what we can share and when?

Please reply with clear yes/no/ETA inline. I will consolidate and send a single slide for the execs.

Thanks,
